subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add generic observation-only reaction hook names and payloads to the public plugin API now, and should the first implementation be Discord-only or cross-channel?
rationale: Source inspection proves the gap, but choosing hook names, payload semantics, enrichment behavior, and cross-channel scope changes the public plugin contract and needs maintainer API intent.

options.title: Approve Generic Observation Hooks
options.body: Add `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` as observation-only public hooks with a shared payload shape, wire Discord first, and document how other channels should converge.

options.title: Scope To Discord First
options.body: Accept a Discord-only hook implementation now, but require explicit follow-up constraints so cross-channel payload drift does not become permanent.

options.title: Defer Hook Surface
options.body: Keep reaction automation on system events or external workarounds until maintainers sponsor a broader plugin-hook design.

recommendation.title: Approve Generic Observation Hooks
recommendation.body: Add `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` as observation-only public hooks with a shared payload shape, wire Discord first, and document how other channels should converge.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is public plugin hook API shape, and recent hook contract history points to vincentkoc.
